dimensions.assessment: Affects visa applicants, embassy and consulate staff, and congressional committees receiving the mandated report.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of State shall submit to Congress a report regarding the adequacy of staffing levels at United States embassies and consulates

dimensions.assessment: Primarily administrative requirements involving reporting, public website disclosures of average wait times, and strategic planning.
dimensions.evidence: publish monthly on a publically accessible website... information regarding the previous average and current estimated time between an interview for a visa and the adjudication

dimensions.assessment: No new federal appropriations or spending figures are specified in the text.
Establishes administrative reporting, public disclosure mandates, and planning directives for the Department of State.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall develop a strategic plan to increase staffing levels at consular offices and embassies

dimensions.assessment: Combines a 90-day initial report with ongoing monthly data publication obligations.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of State shall submit to Congress a report

missing_information: Resources or funding required to execute the strategic plan for increased staffing are not detailed.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the Secretary of State to submit a one-time report on embassy staffing, social media vetting policies, and visa wait times, publish monthly wait times online, and develop a strategic staffing plan.
